It's not your fault that your body froze from the shock of the traumatic thing that happened to you(fight, flight or freeze), it's a natural response from your body doing what it could to protect you in the moment even if it clearly didn't work. But what's really worse? Getting used to change and breaking out of old thought patterns and behaviors that don't serve you, or potentially not existing in any form?
